help_text: Damage and healing effects are reversed. Taking damage restores HP, while healing reduces it.

name: Disable
help_text: The character is unable to act. Remove with a Remedy. (Requires the proper license.)

name: Immobilize

name: Disease

name: Lure

name: Protect

name: Shell

name: Haste

name: Bravery

name: Faith

name: Reflect

name: Invisible

name: Regen
